title: Shared scalar forms of the Fact wire specification
description: Structural only, and subordinate to FACT_WIRE.md: what a pattern cannot say (decimal range, calendar validity, the identity frame, the laws) is in the text and the corpus.

seriesAddress.description: A series address (§5.3): a sha256 content address, or an opaque host key that is not in a content-hash form. The text, not this schema, draws the line between the two.

decimal.description: Decimal text (§3.3): the text is the value, and its scale is significant.

instant.description: A UTC instant in its canonical wire text (§3.4): no fraction when whole, otherwise at most seven digits and no trailing zero.
